title: Construct and independently review the Case 002 citation-lineage dossier
objective: Transform the accepted EM-0026 agent-citation trace packet into one disclosure-safe, reversible Case 002 dossier whose propositions, exact spans, dependence relations, unresolved citations, and policy-relative evaluations are mechanically derived and independently reviewed without admitting or publishing the dossier.
required_evaluation: byte-for-byte preservation of all accepted EM-0026 answers, traces, source readbacks, span readbacks, normalization records, and evidence ledger
strict dossier-format validation, referential closure, content-address recomputation, and public disclosure noninterference
sentence-to-span, edition, work, license, and retrieval-identity closure for every material dossier proposition
relation-derived reproduction of report, citation, URL, work, edition, span, warrant-candidate, unresolved, and no-credit counts
model, prompt, retrieval, benchmark-data, source-work, edition, span, method, derivation, and upstream-citation dependence review
encyclopedia-versus-skeptical policy evaluation with materially different reasons over one unchanged public dossier
fresh-clone independent review of the exact dossier bytes against newly resolved authoritative public editions and the accepted EM-0026 packet
full deterministic make check, disclosure audit, exact path-scope comparison, and clean tracked state
acceptance: one content-addressed Case 002 candidate dossier asks the frozen EM-0026 question with its 2026-08-22 evidence cutoff and does not generalize to current or universal agent behavior

the dossier distinguishes captured reports, citation occurrences, requested URLs, resolving URL roots, source works, examined editions, exact span roots, candidate warrant roots, and independently accepted evidence
all seven EM-0026 candidate warrant roots are represented only at their reviewed scope and none is strengthened into a universal, causal, current-vendor, or cross-metric claim

all four pending warrant groups, nine independently rejected claim occurrences, twenty unsupported or force-raised claim occurrences, thirty-four unresolved citation occurrences, and three inaccessible carriers remain visible and receive no evidentiary credit
the eight captured reports share declared prompt and runtime lineage and are never counted as eight independent epistemic observers

the 8 reports, 48 citation occurrences, 30 cited URLs, 27 resolving URL roots, 11 works, 14 editions, 72 matched span roots, 7 candidate warrant roots, 34 unresolved citations, and 20 unsupported or force-raised claim occurrences are reproduced from relations rather than copied as editorial totals
every material human-readable sentence closes over the exact source works, examined editions, and quote-minimal spans required to support it
encyclopedia and skeptical evaluations preserve the same source graph while differing materially in reliance threshold, unresolved-gap treatment, and reader upshot

an independently rooted reviewer binds the exact candidate dossier path, bytes, digest, reviewed head, source identities, span coverage, dependence relations, displayed counts, limitations, and decision in a machine-readable receipt
the result remains a reviewed research candidate with no catalog selection, public feature, deployment, or claim of production availability
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: This task constructs and reviews a candidate dossier; it does not admit, feature, publish, deploy, or describe Case 002 as live.

Independent review verifies source identity, span containment, semantic scope, lineage, counts, and disclosure. It does not establish that every evaluated agent claim is true or that the bounded sample represents agents generally.

No new agent run, paid provider call, account, credential, private trace, hidden reasoning, restricted source redistribution, policy change, schema promotion, workflow mutation, DNS action, package release, or spend is authorized.
If exact sentence-to-source closure or independence review cannot be completed, the dossier fails closed and the EM-0026 negative-result value remains intact.
